title: S8 — the easy war: segmentation robustness + matcher/rerank + gated CNN integration toward 98
desc: easy is the closest bar and the official suite reads 22/100. Lift it: segmentation robustness on touching/over-split glyphs (the dominant disease), case-twin decision + rerank tuning, native-scale matcher, CNN integrated into the easy path behind a confidence gate. Integrate only held-out-surviving levers (the combine's +3.1 is real; most augmentations were not). Every candidate measured with bench on the official suites, held-out seeds; no in-sample numbers in headlines.
